label: Закрытый
description: A 10-sentence card for закрытый, the past passive participle of закрыть, with its short form закрыт.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative long form. Закрытый comes from the perfective закрыть — the stem закры- plus the suffix -т- and an adjective ending. The long form agrees with masculine гараж.

missions.phrase: Закрытая дверь не пускала нас внутрь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine nominative long form. The long participle takes -ая to agree with дверь. Закрытая дверь equals дверь, которую закрыли — the door that someone closed.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative long form. Закрытое carries the neuter ending -ое to match окно. The -т- suffix marks the result — the window that had been closed.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative long form. The plural ending -ые lets закрытые agree with ставни as the closed shutters that darkened the room.
Strategic focus: Masculine short form. The short predicative form закрыт agrees only in masculine gender with магазин, with быть in the present understood. The shop is closed.
Strategic focus: Feminine short form with быть. The short form закрыта joins была to form a past passive: касса была закрыта. It reports that the till was shut.
Strategic focus: Plural short form. The plural short form закрыты agrees with окна and predicates the result with быть understood. The windows are all shut.

missions.phrase: Я стучу в закрытую дверь долго.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine accusative long form. With the object дверь after в the participle takes the accusative -ую, so закрытую matches it in gender, number and case as the door that was closed.

missions.phrase: Мы стоим перед закрытыми воротами завода.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural instrumental long form. After перед the noun воротами stands in the instrumental, and закрытыми takes the matching plural instrumental ending to agree with it.

missions.phrase: Свет не проникал из-за закрытого окна.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Neuter genitive long form. Закрытого takes the neuter genitive ending to agree with окна after из-за, marking the cause — the window that was closed.
